nodalMinistry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
briefDescription: Income support of Rs. 6000/- per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6000/- per annum.

schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
nodalMinistry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
briefDescription: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility: Families identified on the basis of SECC 2011 occupational and deprivation criteria.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,000,000 per family per annum.

nodalMinistry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
briefDescription: Addresses urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house.
eligibility: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in any part of India.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans.

briefDescription: Loans up to 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen having a non-farm income-generating business plan.
benefits: Collateral-free loans under Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k-5L), and Tarun (5L-10L) categories.

schemeName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
nodalMinistry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
briefDescription: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume their livelihoods.
eligibility: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020.
benefits: Working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 with interest subsidy of 7%.
